docs.title: Welcome to the nomad-battery-space documentation
docs.text: A NOMAD plugin for documenting battery research at HZB.

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
nomad-battery-space provides ELN entries for the whole preparation chain of a battery cell: from purchased chemicals, via synthesized electrode materials, cast electrode sheets, electrolyte and separator stocks, to the electrode, electrolyte and separator samples that are assembled into a cell. Measurement data can be attached to every step.

All entries are linked, so each cell can be traced back to the materials it was made from, and cells can be searched by the chemical elements of their components.

docs.title: Battery Cells
docs.text:
A battery cell entry combines the samples that were assembled into one cell: electrodes, separator and electrolyte.

There are two kinds of cell entries:

  • the generic Battery Sample, which works for every cell format, and
  • specialized cell types for specific formats. They have all fields of the battery sample plus fields for their format.

docs.title: Battery Sample
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Generic Sample · Class: BatterySample

The generic cell entry, used for any cell format. It is also the base of all specialized cell types. Use it for formats that have no specialized type yet.

Field Required Description battery ID (lab_id) Yes Human-readable ID of the cell, unique at least within the lab. battery name (name) Yes Name of the entry. datetime Date and time of assembly. working electrode The Electrode Sample used as working electrode. counter electrode The Electrode Sample used as counter electrode. reference electrode Optional, for three-electrode setups. separator The Separator Sample. electrolyte The Electrolyte Sample. procedure sketch Photo or PDF of the assembly procedure or a technical drawing. aggregated elements Filled automatically from all components, see Aggregated elements. product info / supplier For bought cells. sample identifiers Further identifiers (collapsed by default). notes Free text.

Electrodes are named by their function in the measurement (working, counter, reference), not by their polarity: whether the working electrode is the anode or the cathode depends on the setup.

data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.BatterySample
  lab_id: BAT_001
  name: half_cell_NMC111_01
  datetime: 2026-01-15T10:30:00Z
  working_electrode: '../upload/archive/mainfile/NMC111_sheet_01_disc_03.archive.yaml#data'
  counter_electrode: '../upload/archive/mainfile/Li_foil_disc_01.archive.yaml#data'
  separator: '../upload/archive/mainfile/Celgard_2400_disc_01.archive.yaml#data'
  electrolyte: '../upload/archive/mainfile/LP30_cell_01.archive.yaml#data'

docs.title: Specialized cell types
docs.text:
A specialized cell type extends the Battery Sample with fields for one cell format, e.g. the case or the crimping of a coin cell. Electrodes, separator, electrolyte and the aggregation of elements work the same for all of them.

Currently available:

Cell type ELN label Class Coin Cell HZB Battery: Coin Cell CoinCellBattery

More cell types will be added.

docs.title: Coin Cell
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Coin Cell · Class: CoinCellBattery

A coin cell. It has all fields of the Battery Sample plus:

Field Unit Description case-id Case code: the first two digits are the diameter in mm, the last two the height in 0.1 mm. Suggestions: 2032 (20 mm × 3.2 mm), 2025 (20 mm × 2.5 mm), operando (self-built cells for in-situ measurements). Other values are allowed. case-crimp manual (default) or automatic. pressure MPa Crimping pressure. Only used for automatic crimping; for manual crimping it is cleared on save. 
data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_assembly_package.CoinCellBattery
  lab_id: CC_001
  name: coin_cell_01
  datetime: 2026-01-15T10:30:00Z
  case_id: '2032'
  case_crimp: automatic
  pressure: 0.8
  working_electrode: '../upload/archive/mainfile/NMC111_sheet_01_disc_03.archive.yaml#data'
  counter_electrode: '../upload/archive/mainfile/Li_foil_disc_01.archive.yaml#data'
  separator: '../upload/archive/mainfile/Celgard_2400_disc_01.archive.yaml#data'
  electrolyte: '../upload/archive/mainfile/LP30_cell_01.archive.yaml#data'

docs.title: Materials and Components
docs.text:
This page describes all entry types below the cell level: the chemical, the four stock types and the three sample types. For how they are connected, see Links between entries.

All of these entry types are based on NOMAD's ELNSubstance. They share:

  • name: the name of the entry.
  • lab ID: a human-readable ID. Other entries can reference this entry by its lab ID.
  • substance identifiers: further identifiers (collapsed by default).
  • notes: a free text field for anything not covered by the other fields, see Notes.

All except the chemical also have aggregated elements, which are filled automatically, see Aggregated elements.

Stocks and the chemical additionally have elemental composition and pure substance from ELNSubstance. For samples these fields are hidden, because their composition comes from the stock they were cut from.

The fields chemicals, product info, dimensions and weights and volume and weights appear in several entry types. They are described once in the Reference.

docs.title: Chemical
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Chemical · Class: BS_Chemical

A substance purchased from a supplier. Chemicals are the starting material for electrode materials, electrode sheets, electrolyte stocks and separator stocks.

Field Description name Name of the chemical. elemental composition Elements of the chemical. They are passed on to every entry that uses this chemical. pure substance Optional PubChem-based substance information. product info / supplier Supplier, product and lot number, see Product info.

docs.title: Electrode Material
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Electrode Material · Class: ElectrodeMaterial

An active or auxiliary electrode material, either synthesized in the lab or bought (e.g. NMC111, graphite, carbon black).

Field Unit Description name Name of the material. synthesis Synthesis from chemicals: steps, instruments and publication references (DOI, paper URL). precursor materials Electrode materials this material was derived from by processing. See Precursors and processing. processing How this material was obtained from its precursors: steps and instruments. Only filled in the derived material, not in the precursor. yield % Synthesis yield. volume and weights mL, g Volume and mass of the batch. elemental composition Elements of the material. chemicals Chemicals used for the synthesis, with role and amount. product info / supplier For bought materials.

Synthesis or processing?

  • Synthesis makes a new material from chemicals.
  • Processing changes an existing electrode material, e.g. sieving or spray drying into a coarse, a medium and a fine fraction. Each fraction becomes its own new electrode material with the original material as precursor.

Processing is always described in the new entry

Precursors and processing are filled in the new entry (e.g. the fine fraction), not in the original material. They describe how this new material was obtained from its precursor. The original entry stays unchanged. See Precursors and processing for the step-by-step workflow.

data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.ElectrodeMaterial
  name: NMC111_200um
  yield_percent: 0.95
  elemental_composition:
    - element: Li
    - element: Ni
    - element: Mn
    - element: Co
    - element: O
  synthesis:
    name: milling
    steps:
      - name: milling with 200 um beads
        duration: 3600

docs.title: Electrode Sheet
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Electrode Sheet · Class: ElectrodeSheet

A cast or coated electrode sheet, made from electrode materials (active material, binder, conductive agent, current collector, ...). Electrode samples are punched from it.

Field Unit Description name Name of the sheet. casting procedure E.g. doctor blade casting, spray coating, dip coating, printing, dry casting, roll casting. Free text is allowed. dimensions and weights µm, g Thickness, mass and shape of the sheet. elemental composition Additional elements of the sheet. chemicals Chemicals used directly, e.g. the solvent of the slurry. electrode materials The electrode materials in the sheet, each with role (active material, binder, conductive agent, additive, current collector), mass (mg) and wt%. product info / supplier For bought sheets. 
data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.ElectrodeSheet
  name: NMC111_sheet_01
  casting_procedure: Doctor blade casting
  dimensions_and_weights:
    thickness: 80
  electrode_materials:
    - material: '../upload/archive/mainfile/NMC111_200um.archive.yaml#data'
      role: active material
      wt_percent: 90
    - material: '../upload/archive/mainfile/PVDF.archive.yaml#data'
      role: binder
      wt_percent: 5
    - material: '../upload/archive/mainfile/carbon_black.archive.yaml#data'
      role: conductive agent
      wt_percent: 5

docs.title: Electrolyte Stock
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Electrolyte Stock · Class: ElectrolyteStock

An electrolyte batch, mixed from salts and solvents in the lab or bought (e.g. LP30).

Field Unit Description name Name of the electrolyte. state Liquid (default) or Solid. precursor electrolyte stocks Electrolyte stocks this stock was derived from, e.g. by drying or adding an additive. processing How this stock was obtained from its precursors. Only filled in the derived stock, not in the precursor. volume and weights mL, g Volume and mass of the batch. elemental composition Elements of the electrolyte. chemicals Salts, solvents and additives with role, amount and concentration. product info / supplier For bought electrolytes.

An electrolyte stock has no synthesis section: mixing is documented through the chemicals and their concentrations.

data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.ElectrolyteStock
  name: LP30
  state: Liquid
  elemental_composition:
    - element: Li
    - element: P
    - element: F
    - element: C
    - element: H
    - element: O

docs.title: Separator Stock
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Separator Stock · Class: SeparatorStock

A separator material (e.g. a porous polymer film, glass fibre, a ceramic-coated film). Separator samples are cut from it.

Field Unit Description name Name of the separator. synthesis Synthesis from chemicals, e.g. extrusion. precursor separator stocks Separator stocks this stock was derived from, e.g. by coating. processing How this stock was obtained from its precursors. Only filled in the derived stock, not in the precursor. dimensions and weights µm, g Thickness, mass and shape. The thickness is passed on to the separator samples. elemental composition Elements of the separator. chemicals Chemicals used. product info / supplier For bought separators. 
data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.SeparatorStock
  name: Celgard_2400
  elemental_composition:
    - element: C
    - element: H
  synthesis:
    name: extrusion

docs.title: Electrode Sample
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Electrode Sample · Class: ElectrodeSample

A piece cut or punched from an electrode sheet, ready to go into a cell.

Field Unit Description name Name of the sample. electrode sheet The sheet the sample was cut from. dimensions and weights µm, g Thickness, mass and shape (circle, rectangle or other) of the sample. chemicals Chemicals used directly on the sample. product info / supplier For bought electrodes.

If no thickness is entered, the sample takes the thickness of its electrode sheet.

data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.ElectrodeSample
  name: NMC111_sheet_01_disc_03
  electrode_sheet: '../upload/archive/mainfile/NMC111_sheet_01.archive.yaml#data'
  dimensions_and_weights:
    mass: 0.012
    shape:
      m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.utilities.geometry.CircleGeometry
      diameter: 12

docs.title: Electrolyte Sample
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Electrolyte Sample · Class: ElectrolyteSample

The amount of electrolyte taken from an electrolyte stock for one cell.

Field Unit Description name Name of the sample. electrolyte stock The stock the electrolyte was taken from. volume and weights mL, g Dosed volume and mass. product info / supplier For bought electrolytes. 
data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.ElectrolyteSample
  name: LP30_cell_01
  electrolyte_stock: '../upload/archive/mainfile/LP30.archive.yaml#data'
  volume_and_weights:
    volume: 0.08

docs.title: Separator Sample
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Separator Sample · Class: SeparatorSample

A piece cut from a separator stock for one cell.

Field Unit Description name Name of the sample. separator stock The stock the separator was cut from. dimensions and weights µm, g Thickness, mass and shape of the sample. product info / supplier For bought separators.

If no thickness is entered, the sample takes the thickness of its separator stock.

docs.title: Measurements
docs.text:
ELN label: HZB Battery: Measurement · Class: BS_Measurement

A measurement entry stores the raw data files of a measurement and links them to the measured samples. Any file format can be uploaded (e.g. .dta, .nxs, .txtr). The files are stored as they are; their content is not read by the plugin.

Field Description name Name of the measurement. datetime Date and time of the measurement. operator Person who did the measurement. method Measurement method, e.g. galvanostatic cycling. data files One or more raw data files of any format. description Free text. samples The measured samples.

docs.title: Which samples can be measured
docs.text:
The samples list accepts every entry of the plugin: chemicals, electrode materials, electrode sheets, stocks, samples and cells. Intermediates created by processing can therefore be measured, too.

A sample can be linked in two ways:

  • Select the entry in the reference field. This is the recommended way: you see which entry you link.
  • Enter its lab ID. The matching entry is looked up when the measurement is saved. This is useful if you know the ID but do not want to search the list, e.g. when creating measurements from YAML files.

When you enter a lab ID, check the result after saving:

  • The sample entry must already exist and have this lab ID. If no entry is found, the reference stays empty.
  • If several entries have the same lab ID, the first one found is used. Which one that is cannot be predicted, so select the entry from the list in this case.

A measurement can also be saved without samples and linked later.

data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_measurement_package.BS_Measurement
  name: cell_01 cycling
  datetime: 2026-01-20T09:00:00Z
  method: galvanostatic cycling
  operator: Jane Doe
  data_file:
    - cell_01_cycling.dta
    - cell_01_operando.nxs
  samples:
    - lab_id: CC_001

The data files must be part of the same upload.

docs.title: Data Model Overview
docs.text:
The nomad-battery-space plugin documents battery research along the way a cell is actually built in the lab: from purchased chemicals, via synthesized materials and cast sheets, to the pieces that go into a cell, and finally to the assembled cell and the measurements done on it.

Every step is its own ELN entry. Entries are connected by references, so each cell can be traced back to the materials and chemicals it was made from.

docs.title: The preparation chain
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    subgraph Chain ["Any entry of the chain"]
        direction LR
        CH[Chemical]

        subgraph Stock ["Stock (batch level)"]
            EM[Electrode Material]
            ES[Electrode Sheet]
            EL[Electrolyte Stock]
            SE[Separator Stock]
        end

        subgraph Sample ["Sample (cell level)"]
            EDS[Electrode Sample]
            ELS[Electrolyte Sample]
            SES[Separator Sample]
        end

        CELL[Battery Cell]

        CH --> EM
        CH --> ES
        CH --> EL
        CH --> SE
        EM --> ES
        EM -. processing .-> EM
        EL -. processing .-> EL
        SE -. processing .-> SE
        ES -- cut from --> EDS
        EL -- taken from --> ELS
        SE -- cut from --> SES
        EDS --> CELL
        ELS --> CELL
        SES --> CELL
    end

    M[Measurement]
    Chain -. measured .-> M

The model has three levels:

Level Entry types What it represents Chemical Chemical A substance bought from a supplier, the starting point of every chain. Stock Electrode Material, Electrode Sheet, Electrolyte Stock, Separator Stock A batch that is synthesized, mixed or bought once and used for many cells. Sample Electrode Sample, Electrolyte Sample, Separator Sample The individual piece that goes into one cell: a punched electrode, a dosed amount of electrolyte, a cut separator.

On top of these, the battery cell entries combine the samples into an assembled cell: either the generic battery sample or a specialized type for a specific cell format.

Measurements store raw data files and can be linked to any entry type of the chain.

Example: coin cell set-up (click to expand)

How the entries are used for a coin cell: on the left the entries you create before the assembly, on the right the coin cell entry, which references the samples in their roles (working, counter and reference electrode, electrolyte, separator).

Click the image to enlarge it.

docs.title: Design principles
docs.text:
• One entry per physical object. A stock is created once and referenced by every sample cut from it. Properties are stored in one place.
  • Traceability by reference. Entries point to their inputs. The links are listed in Links between entries.
  • Derived samples keep their type. A spray-dried electrode material is again an electrode material, linked to its precursor by a processing step. This way, intermediates can be measured too.
  • Bought or made. Every stock and sample can either be made in the lab (with chemicals, synthesis or processing) or bought (with product information).
  • Searchable composition. The chemical elements of all inputs are collected upwards, so a cell can be found by the elements of its electrodes and electrolyte. See Aggregated elements.

docs.title: Links between Entries
docs.text: Entries in nomad-battery-space do not copy data from each other. They reference the entries they were made from. This page lists the kinds of links and the values that are filled in automatically along them.

docs.title: Kinds of links
docs.text:
Link From → To Meaning chemicals Electrode Material, Electrode Sheet, Electrolyte Stock, Separator Stock, Electrode Sample → Chemical These chemicals were used, with role and amount. electrode materials Electrode Sheet → Electrode Material The sheet contains these materials, with role, mass and wt%. precursors + processing Electrode Material → Electrode Material, Electrolyte Stock → Electrolyte Stock, Separator Stock → Separator Stock This entry was derived from another entry of the same type by processing. cut / taken from Electrode Sample → Electrode Sheet, Electrolyte Sample → Electrolyte Stock, Separator Sample → Separator Stock This sample is a piece of that stock; the material is unchanged. cell components Battery Sample → Electrode Sample, Electrolyte Sample, Separator Sample These samples were assembled into the cell. samples Measurement → any sample This sample was measured.

In the ELN, a link is set with the reference field: choose an existing entry or create a new one with the + button. In YAML, a reference to an entry in the same upload is written as:

electrolyte_stock: '../upload/archive/mainfile/LP30.archive.yaml#data'

docs.title: Chemicals with amounts
docs.text:
A chemicals entry not only points to a Chemical but also records how it was used:

Field Unit Description chemical The referenced chemical. role Solvent, precursor, dopant, binder, electrolyte salt, additive or other. Free text is allowed. volume mL Volume used. mass g Mass used. molar concentration mol/L mass concentration g/L fraction %, ppm Mass, volume or mole fraction. mass fraction (wt%) 0 to 100. volume fraction (% V/V)

The name of the chemical is filled in automatically, so the list of chemicals in the ELN shows readable names.

The same applies to the electrode materials of an electrode sheet: each entry points to an Electrode Material and has a role, a mass (mg) and wt%.

docs.title: Derived from another entry: precursors and processing
docs.text:
Some materials are made by modifying an existing material instead of synthesizing a new one, for example:

  • an electrode material that is spray-dried into coarse, medium and fine fractions,
  • an electrolyte that is dried or gets an additive,
  • a separator that is coated.

The result of such a step is a new entry of the same type. The existing material is its precursor (parent), the new entry is the derived entry (child).

Processing is always described in the new entry

Fill in precursors and processing in the new entry, not in the existing one. The processing section answers the question: how was this entry obtained from its precursor?

The precursor entry stays as it is. Its own processing section is only used if the precursor itself was derived from another entry.

flowchart LR
    P["NMC111_200um<br/>(precursor, unchanged)"]
    C["NMC111_spray_dried_fine<br/>precursors: NMC111_200um<br/>processing: spray drying, sieving"]
    P -- "is precursor of" --> C

docs.title: Workflow in the ELN
docs.text:
1. Make sure the existing material has an entry, e.g. NMC111_200um. Do not change it.
  2. Create a new entry of the same type, e.g. a new Electrode Material NMC111_spray_dried_fine.
  3. In the new entry, add the existing material under precursors by selecting it from the list. Entering its lab ID also works, with the same limitations as for measurements.
  4. In the new entry, describe under processing what was done to get from the precursor to this material: name, date, steps and instruments.
  5. Fill in the properties of the new material as usual, e.g. volume and weights.

If one material is split into several results, e.g. a coarse, a medium and a fine fraction, create one new entry per result. Each of them has the same precursor and its own processing.

If a material goes through several steps one after another, create one entry per intermediate you want to keep, e.g. to measure it. Each entry has the previous one as precursor. If the intermediates are not needed, one entry with several processing steps is enough.

data:
  m_def: nomad_battery_space.schema_packages.hzb_bs_package.ElectrodeMaterial
  name: NMC111_spray_dried_fine
  precursors:
    - reference: '../upload/archive/mainfile/NMC111_200um.archive.yaml#data'
  processing:
    name: spray drying
    steps:
      - name: spray drying
      - name: sieving, fine fraction

Because the result keeps its type, it can be used everywhere the original could: a spray-dried electrode material can go into an electrode sheet, and each intermediate can be measured on its own.

The elements of the precursor are taken over automatically, see Aggregated elements.

Processing vs. cut from: processing changes the material (new properties, new entry of the same type). Cut from takes a piece of an unchanged stock to use it in a cell (from stock level to sample level).

docs.title: Values filled in automatically
docs.text:
When an entry is saved, some values are taken from the entries it references. They are only filled if the field is still empty, unless noted otherwise.

Value Source Applies to aggregated elements (always recalculated) All referenced entries, see below All entry types except Chemical and Measurement mass, volume product_weight and product_volume of the product info All entries with product info and volume or dimensions thickness Electrode sheet Electrode Sample thickness Separator stock Separator Sample area Diameter, or length × width Circle and rectangle geometry chemical / material name Referenced chemical or electrode material Chemicals and electrode material lists pressure (cleared) Set to empty for manual crimping Coin Cell

docs.title: Aggregated elements
docs.text:
Every entry collects the chemical elements of everything it was made from:

  • its own elemental composition,
  • the referenced chemicals,
  • the referenced electrode materials (electrode sheet),
  • the precursors,
  • the stock it was cut from,
  • for a cell: all its electrodes, separator and electrolyte.

The result is stored in aggregated elements and in the search index of NOMAD. A cell with an NMC111 cathode can therefore be found in the HZB sample search app by filtering for Ni, Mn or Co, although these elements were only entered in the electrode material.

Referenced entries contribute their own aggregated elements, so the elements are passed on through the whole chain.

docs.title: Contribute to This Plugin
docs.text: Contributions to the development or documentation of the nomad-battery-plugin are welcome. If you have a general feedback or suggestions to improve the plugin, please get in touch by opening an issue in the plugin repository or get in touch with the authors.

docs.title: Install This Plugin
docs.text:
To include this plugin as part of your local or institutional NOMAD Oasis the following line needs to be added to the pyproject.toml file of the Oasis repo: 

[project.optional-dependencies]
plugins = [
 'nomad-battery-space @ git+https://github.com/nomad-hzb/nomad-battery-space.git',
]

For a detailed guide on how to setup and install a new Oasis, see the Tutorial 13 part 4 or NOMAD Documentation.

docs.title: Product info
docs.text:
product info / supplier, for bought items. Available in every entry type except Measurement.

Field Unit product number lot number product volume mL product weight g shipping date opening date supplier product description cost

If the entry has a volume and weights or dimensions and weights section and its mass or volume is empty, the product weight and product volume are copied there.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text: A rich text field for anything that is not covered by the other fields. Available in every entry type except Measurement.

docs.title: Schema packages
docs.text: Entry point Content hzb_bs_package Chemical, stocks, samples and the generic battery sample. hzb_bs_assembly_package Specialized cell types (currently the coin cell). hzb_bs_measurement_package Measurement. hzb_utilities_processing Precursors and processing, shared by all stock types. hzb_utilities_dimensions Dimensions and weights, volume and weights. hzb_utilities_geometry Circle, rectangle and other geometry. hzb_utilities_notes Notes. hzb_utilities_voila_notebook Voila notebooks.

docs.title: Apps
docs.text: App Description HZB sample search app Search for battery entries, e.g. by entry type, lab ID or elements. Voila Find and launch Voila tools for battery space data.
